source: Python assessment_tools.py reference before Bun migration

cards.title: Protected-stock delivery
cards.difficulty_intent: query hidden state, plan transfers under reserves/capacity, or prove impossibility
cards.prompt: Use the inventory tools to get warehouse C to exactly 5 units. Preserve all protected minimum stocks, do not exceed capacities, and use only allowed routes and per-transfer quantities. Initial stocks are not supplied; inspect them. There is no external stock source. If achievable, finish with an answer object {"status":"done","stock":{"A":integer,"B":integer,"C":integer}} matching actual stock. If impossible, do not attempt an illegal transfer: report {"status":"impossible","max_C":integer}, where max_C is the maximum achievable C stock under the rules. Legal transfers may be split or reordered.

tools.name: inspect_inventory
tools.description: Read all current stocks, protected reserves, capacity and legal transfer routes.

tools.name: transfer_stock
tools.description: Transfer a positive integer quantity along a permitted route. Errors leave state unchanged.

measurement.confounds: Feasible/impossible variants are a shared family, not independent dimensions. Tool unsupported is a runner outcome.

cards.scoring_rule: Equal mean of state feasibility/goal, truthful final report, observed inventory, and invariant/no-invalid-attempt checks. No calls scores zero. Also retain full tool_checks; no trace-string matching.

cards.title: Reserve a meeting despite a revision conflict
cards.difficulty_intent: tool selection, optimistic concurrency, feedback adaptation
cards.prompt: Book exactly one 2-hour meeting for 8 people in a room with a projector. Start must be an integer hour, at or after 9, and end no later than 12. Discover rooms and availability through tools. Use revisions when reserving. Another user may reserve a slot between your read and write; a revision_conflict returns authoritative current availability and revision. Adapt to feedback; never overwrite existing bookings, and do not book an unsuitable room. Finish with an answer object {"status":"booked","room":string,"start":integer,"duration":integer} matching the actual reservation, or report impossibility if no legal slot exists.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List room IDs and equipment/capacity; does not reserve a room.

tools.name: room_availability
tools.description: Read current free integer-hour slots and revision for one room.

tools.name: reserve_room
tools.description: Reserve consecutive slots using the observed revision. On conflict, read returned current availability and retry if feasible.

measurement.confounds: One fixed external change; not real distributed-systems reliability or long-horizon agency.

cards.scoring_rule: Equal mean of actual correct reservation, truthful final report, successful conflict recovery and no invalid attempts; retain full tool_checks. No calls scores zero. Room/availability evidence may come from queries or authoritative conflict feedback.
